correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md gives exactly n triangles T_i of C_n^2 for every n>=7, 2n edges and n vertices; vertex links form a surface, boundary edges {i,i+2} form gcd(n,2) circles, and Euler characteristic zero determines annulus or Mobius. No rotation-stabilized nonempty simplex exists: an orbit of size two is antipodal distance >=3 and orbit of size three spacing >=3. The invariant face poset of each reflection has components of cardinalities (3,1), (3,3) or (1,1), geometrically interval-plus-point/two intervals/two points. Cyclic quotient boundary parity gives annulus/Mobius; for any reflected subgroup rotations are free, fixed-set Euler=2 per reflection and Burnside quotient Euler=1. A surface quotient with boundary and chi=1 is disk. I independently reviewed the package verifier combinatorics; its n=7..30 range is corroboration only, not used to infer n>=7 proof. Important local mirror-versus-isolated halfturn neighborhoods do not prevent the quotient being a surface.
